userStories.title: Remove dead buildMergeDescription function
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need the never-called private buildMergeDescription function removed from src/commands/issue-specify.ts so that the module has no dead code masked by knip's 'exports' exclusion and tsc's noUnusedLocals:false.
acceptanceCriteria: Before editing, the implementer re-greps to confirm zero callers exist beyond the definition itself (defensive check at HEAD). [oracle: bun -e "const n=require('child_process').execSync('grep -rn buildMergeDescription src/ test/').toString().trim().split('\n').length; if(n!==1) throw new Error('expected exactly 1 hit pre-removal, got '+n)"]

The buildMergeDescription function body is fully removed from src/commands/issue-specify.ts and no reference to the identifier remains anywhere in src/ or test/. [oracle: file-assert ! grep -rq buildMergeDescription src/ test/]

Any import or private helper in src/commands/issue-specify.ts that became orphaned solely because buildMergeDescription was removed is also removed; helpers/imports still used elsewhere are left intact (the function body only does string interpolation, so this is expected to be a no-op, but the implementer must confirm). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Full spine including knip passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
Tests pass (bun test); behavior is unchanged because the function was never invoked. [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: File: src/commands/issue-specify.ts. The dead function is at ~line 261: `function buildMergeDescription(existing: string | undefined, intoId: string): string { ... }`. It is module-PRIVATE (not exported), which is why knip (knip.json excludes 'exports') and tsc (noUnusedLocals:false) both miss it. Verified live: `grep -rn buildMergeDescription src/ test/` returns EXACTLY ONE hit (the definition); ZERO callers. mergeIssueOnMain builds the merge note inline in buildMergeFiles, not via this function. The body references only template-string interpolation (`Merged into ${intoId}.`), no imports or private helpers, so removal orphans nothing; still re-verify via typecheck. Context: flagged as an out-of-scope SUGGESTION during the CAM-133 review; the dead code predates the CAM-133 branch (already in main). Surgical removal only: do NOT touch buildMergeFiles, mergeIssueOnMain, emitStagePromoted, or any other code.
